item.title: Govt Proposes Mandatory Energy Storage for Large Renewable Prosumers
item.description: The Ministry of Power has issued the Draft Electricity (Rights of Consumers) Amendment Rules, 2026, proposing several changes aimed at modernising the consumer protection framework for solar consumers. The new proposal aims at amending its earlier rules introduced in 2020. The draft rules introduce provisions enabling state regulators to mandate energy storage systems for renewable energy prosumers with capacities above 500 kW. item.title: MNRE Data Shows India’s Solar Module Imports Skyrocketed Before 2024 ALMM Reinstatement
item.description: The Ministry of New and Renewable Energy (MNRE) has furnished details of the total imports of solar equipment, primarily solar modules in the four years till 2024-25. The details furnished by the government entails details of the import dependency of the green sector and the exports of solar modules to India. item.description: Large renewable energy IPPs KPI Green and ACME Solar have announced partially commissioning of their solar and battery energy storage projects in Gujarat and Rajasthan respectively. item.title: Stellantis Prices €5 Billion Hybrid Bond Offering After Scaling Back EV Push
item.description: Global automaker Stellantis has priced a multi-tranche hybrid bond offering worth about €5 billion, aimed at strengthening its balance sheet following a major strategic shift in its electric vehicle (EV) plans. The announcement comes weeks after the company disclosed multi-billion-euro charges linked to a reassessment of its EV expansion strategy. item.description: The Odisha Renewable Energy Development Agency (OREDA) has now issued bids to develop grid-connected rooftop solar projects on government buildings across Odisha. item.title: Gujarat: DCM Shriram Approves Rs 87 Cr To Build 98.4 MW Renewable Energy Project
item.description: DCM Shriram, a business conglomerate, has approved up to Rs. 87 crore in equity investment at its latest Board of Directors meeting. In a regulatory filing, DCM Shriram said the investment would be made in one or more tranches. item.description: Resonia Ltd., a power transmission infrastructure company, has appointed Prashant Sinha as its Chief Executive Officer.
